shopify_hosted.note: Documentation revisions are not Shopify production engine revisions. Generated catalog is a discovery aid; public detail pages override stale omissions.

core_scope_review.hosted_subsystem: Additional functionality, not a JavaScript/Ruby interop requirement: every tag, filter and limit of the shopify_theme profile is flagged for removal under the original core-only target.

options_flagged_for_removal.decision: Template-dialect options with no reference twin. Flagged, not removed: dropping public options is a major-version break.

core_scope_review.retained_host_adaptations: Promises/generators, typed/module packaging, controlled filesystems, prototype defenses, runtime-specific algorithms, render-local filters, strictVariables/strictFilters, catchAllErrors.
